{{Top|leg}}
'''Oxygen extractors''' were devices capable of separating [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] from the surrounding [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], or from subsurface [[Water/Legends|water]] deposits. Depending on the design, some extractors were capable of extracting the oxygen from atmospheres consisting primarily of [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] or [[Methane/Legends|methane]]. Oxygen extractors available on the market included [[Vercanne Mineral Technologies]]' [[FOE-2000]], and [[Gandorthral Atmospherics/Legends|Gandorthral Atmospherics]] [[Oxidizer]].
